models.name: ViT-Small (Full Fine-Tuning)
models.description: Standard fully fine-tuned Vision Transformer. Achieves top in-domain accuracy (98.96%) but requires complete gradient backpropagation across all 21.7M parameters.

models.name: ViT-Small (Unfreeze Last 3)
models.description: Recommended Pareto-optimal model. Trains only the final 3 transformer blocks (5.3M parameters, 24.6% of backbone), matching full fine-tuning within 1.0% accuracy while saving memory and preserving attribution faithfulness.

models.name: ViT-Small (Unfreeze Last 2)
models.description: Highly parameter-efficient model unfreezing only the final 2 transformer blocks (3.55M parameters, 16.4%).

models.name: ViT-Small (Linear Probe)
models.description: Frozen backbone; trains only the linear classification head (3,850 parameters). Fastest to train, evaluates raw self-supervised representations.

models.name: DeiT-Small (Full Fine-Tuning)
models.description: Data-efficient Image Transformer (DeiT) distilled backbone, fully fine-tuned.

models.name: DeiT-Small (Unfreeze Last 3)
models.description: DeiT-Small with final 3 blocks unfrozen. Preserves strong distillation representations.

models.name: Swin-Tiny (Full Fine-Tuning)
models.description: Hierarchical Swin Transformer with shifted windows, fully fine-tuned across all stages (27.5M params).

models.name: Swin-Tiny (Unfreeze Last 3)
models.description: Hierarchical Swin Transformer with final 3 blocks unfrozen.
